# mq-task

> mq-task is a task runner that executes code blocks in Markdown files, selected by section title. Built on mq (https://mqlang.org/). Supports dependencies, parallel execution, conditions, retries, timeouts, output passing, imports, caching, watch mode, a dependency graph, shell completions and an interactive TUI.

- [Dependencies](https://task.mqlang.org/book/guide/dependencies.html): depends

- [Passing Output Between Tasks](https://task.mqlang.org/book/guide/output.html): capture, MX_OUTPUT_<TASK>
- [Importing Tasks](https://task.mqlang.org/book/guide/imports.html): imports

- [Dependency Graph](https://task.mqlang.org/book/guide/graph.html): mq-task graph
- [Meta keys](https://task.mqlang.org/book/reference/meta.html): All meta keys
- [CLI](https://task.mqlang.org/book/reference/cli.html): Commands and options
- [Exit codes](https://task.mqlang.org/book/reference/exit-codes.html): Exit code behaviour
